                               SCHEDULE OF EMPLOYEES' REMUNERATION AND EXPENSES
                                            YEAR ENDED MARCH 31, 2020



Remuneration includes salary and wages of University employees, including payments to employees for services performed over
and above their regular duties, and payments to employees in connection with retirement (*).

Reimbursement of work-related expenses represents payments for costs incurred by employees in connection with their duties.

fees and similar amounts.

Both remuneration and expenses include amounts provided from grants and contracts administered by the University.
